name: card-dispute-router
rationale: Dispute intake and suspected-fraud reports are independent topics, so separate specialists answer each.

gaps: platform session defaults do not prove user or tenant isolation

controls.not_applicable_reason: topology: a single-agent or router runs no control transfer between agents

capabilities.name: session-history
capabilities.summary: Foundry-managed session store keeps sessions and history; no custom session code is delivered.
capabilities.limits: retention, deletion, tenant authorization and business-case state are separate decisions

capabilities.name: invocation-protocol
capabilities.summary: The standard SDK hosting adapter handles invocation, streaming and continuation.
capabilities.limits: no custom protocol code in this skill

capabilities.name: context-propagation
capabilities.summary: Host-supplied conversation context reaches the application; specialist instructions stay scoped.
capabilities.limits: local context tests are not hosted isolation proof

capabilities.name: bounded-routing
capabilities.summary: Finite classify then at most one tool-less specialist run.
capabilities.limits: underlying SDK/HTTP retries, duration, cost, token limits and cancellation are not bounded

capabilities.name: refusal
capabilities.summary: Blank or unroutable requests have an explicit refusal outcome.
capabilities.limits: no timeout, exception or cancellation recovery; not safe business-action termination

capabilities.name: release-evidence
capabilities.summary: Generated evaluation and pipeline artifacts are declarations until executed.
capabilities.limits: evaluating a candidate version is not evidence that every runtime or security control passed

session.owner: platform (Foundry-managed session store via the SDK hosting integration)
